{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The Nightscreamer also allows installation of a side-car, which can be handy for carrying your slicer droid or transporting a trussed-up acquisition.|Chentu Chek mentioned the side-car in ''Tools of the Trade'', a chapter from the ''Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook''|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
A '''side-car''' was a device that could be installed on the [[88-R Nightscreamer/Legends|88-R Nightscreamer]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]. It increased the transport-space of the bike, allowing for cargo or an additional passenger.<ref name="BHC" />

Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="era">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' indicates that [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] lived at the same time as Chek. Page 4 has an introduction written by [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], who according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', died c. [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Therefore, the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' must have been written sometime prior to 0 ABY, with Chek's section being a recent addition/revision to the book.</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] veteran [[Chentu Chek]] mentioned the side-car in his description of the Nightscreamer in his chapter ''Tools of the Trade'', which was published in the ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]''<ref name="BHC" />
